name: Toyo Suisan Kaisha, Ltd.
summary: Toyo Suisan Kaisha, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells food products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Seafood Business; Overseas Instant Noodles Business; Domestic Instant Noodles Business; Low Temperature Food Business; Refrigeration Business; Processed Food Business; and Others segments. It also purchases, processes, and sells seafood products. In addition, the company manufactures and sells instant cup and bagged noodles, wontons, soup, chilled noodles and foods, frozen food, rice, commercial prepared food, and other processed foods, as well as fish, ham, and sausage.
